searchText: Right. It's a blobscription specific problem. It appears that if you have the same PNG file in the blob and make multiple copies, then they will all have the same reference hash. Seems bizarre but I agree nothing seems to prevent this Blobs actually might be useful for something opposite to nfts, for some collectible content that has more value because it expires. Like newspaper that everyone reads, but few collect as an evidence of epoch. I think there was some website that did podcasts in blobs
